_comment: Gate config for the polyglot runner at ../../gates/. Run: node ../../gates/run-gates.mjs

gates.description: tsc on test files, which tsconfig.app.json excludes
gates._comment: THE HOLE FIX. Without this gate a type error inside a test file ships silently: the app config excludes tests, and vitest transpiles without type-checking. Deleting this gate is how the hole comes back.
--format json is what the eslint parser reads. Plain stylish output parses to nothing and the gate reports itself broken.
--reporter=json is what the vitest parser reads.
